Chapter 2 — Hindenburg

“Hotel in the Sky, the Last Landing”

1937.05.06 FRANKFURT → LAKEHURST

This game is based on the fire that destroyed the airship Hindenburg at Lakehurst, New Jersey, USA, on May 6, 1937. Of the 97 people on board, 35 died, along with one member of the ground crew.

It was made in respect for those who died, to learn and think about what happened and what saved people. The main character and some people and conversations are fictional. Times, numbers and the ship’s interior are based on Wikipedia and airship sources.

Some scenes involve fire, smoke and the number of people who died. If you have been through a painful accident or disaster, please do not push yourself.
